name: Content King: Streamer Simulator
summary:
Content King: Streamer Simulator puts you behind the camera with one goal—build a streaming career from scratch and turn it into something worth watching.

Start with basic gear and zero followers. Stream regularly, improve your content, and grow your audience. Upgrade your setup, manage your time, and decide how you’ll rise—stay genuine, stir the pot, or cut corners for quicker success.

Expand your channel, work with other creators, and turn your online presence into a serious business. Just don’t forget: the internet loves a star—but it loves a scandal even more. Ready to chase clout or chaos? The camera’s on.
